limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and technical reviewer; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

The work lab (openlaw-docs-9d2b1705-work) is shared with other DOC-032 agents. Only records named DOC-032 documents V-C26 09280710 (and the doc032- fixture files) were created and deleted. The run archived its three Document types at its end; archive keeps their labels and colours on the Versions that carry them. The fixed type Partially signed was set to Red and put back to Automatic (its prior value) within one step.

Theme adaptation was checked by setting the page's data-theme presentation attribute to dark (the attribute the theme switch writes) and comparing the pill's computed background, then putting the attribute back; the users' stored theme preferences were not changed. Daniel Okafor's stored theme is Warm, Nadia Haddad's is Light.
Colours were checked by the Purple pill classes (bg-status-assigned-bg) and computed backgrounds, not by visual comparison.

The Auto-Doc template delete refusal was not exercised: the run created no Auto-Doc and used no seeded paper. Source (routes.ts DELETE /documents/:documentId/versions/:versionId answers 409 when the Document has an autoDocId) shows the refusal. A Version generated by an Auto-Doc was also not exercised; source shows its Type cell is read-only.

The Generated redline and the two Comparisons in the delete steps were requested through the lab API as fixture setup; the browser ran every guide step on them. The delete refusal came from the real server answer 409 "A generated comparison version uses this version. Delete that comparison version first."

The failed upload used a controlled 413 browser response; the lab's real upload limit was not reached. The refused type corrections, the refused Version delete and the Legal Team Member's refused delete (403) are real server answers.

Insufficient access used Amara Nwosu, a seeded Business User on the Contract team, in the Portal, and Nadia Haddad for the Delete version negative check. The lab has no Contributor account in this scenario, so the Contributor refusal was not exercised.

Author limitations: the bulk toolbar's Delete versions action is not described in this guide and was not walked. The Administrator's Delete version on an earlier Version of an archived owning record was not tested (the guide does not describe it). The Legal Team Member negative check is confirmed: no Delete version in the row menu or the Actions for version menu, and the API answers 403.
Confirmed the carried product bug: on a Knowledge Item the Type column renders a select and every choice is refused. The guide describes this behavior, so it is not a guide failure.
The Entity empty-list check ran only in the Administrator pass, before the run added its Entity type; the Legal pass saw a non-empty Entity list.
